X is a shiny silver-coloured solid at room temperature and pressure.
X is a good conductor of heat and electricity when solid.
Which statement about X is correct?
A
X is an ionic compound or a metallic element.
B
X is a metallic element or a non-metallic element.
C
X is an alloy or a metallic element.
D
X is an alloy or a non-metallic element.

options.label: A
